task: Keep start-up output (migration banner, update check, what's-new notice) off stdout for --json invocations via a new isMachineOutputInvocation(argv) helper wired into bin/codemie.js, with a stderr warning when a start-up migration fails (EPMCDME-16716).

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: CLI wrapper (bin/codemie.js start-up sequence), machine-output utility (src/utils/machine-output.ts), COMMANDS.md docs

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Minor: `--json <path>` (SDK commands take a file as input) cannot be told apart from the output switch before commander parses argv; accepted as a documented trade-off (silent start-up only moves details to the log file)

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: argv-based heuristic runs on every CLI start-up; false positives only suppress start-up chatter and update prompts; silent migration failure had to be surfaced via stderr
technical_risk.mitigation: Reuses the existing isHookProcess silent-migration pattern in the wrapper; unit tests for the helper plus spawned-CLI integration tests covering stdout purity, skipped update check and the stderr warning; trivially reversible

key_reasoning.reason: Highest-scoring dimension: diffstat reports 5 files (3 modified, 2 new) across bin, docs, src and tests, mapping to M; about 100 insertions and 6 deletions, mostly tests.
One small pure helper and one start-up wrapper edit; no cross-cutting restructuring. Wrapper runs on every invocation but the change is gated to --json argv only.
